ios.desc:
Supplies tracks everything you keep at home: food, cleaning supplies, medicine, and whatever else fills your cupboards, closets, and garage. Add what you have, note where it lives, then see at a glance what's running low, what's about to expire, or what to pick up next time you're out.

KEY FEATURES
- Create multiple inventories: add more inventories beyond your main one, each fully separate with its own items, shopping list, and expiration view.
- Organize by location: sort items by fridge, freezer, or any place you choose, and give every status its own icon and color.
- Watch the expiration timeline: everything groups by urgency, showing what's expired, what's due this week, and what's coming up next.
- Build a shopping list: add what you're running low on and check items off as you shop, right from the interactive home screen widget.
- Make custom checklists: reuse a list for a recipe, a trip, or an emergency kit whenever you need it.
- Share an inventory: let family or housemates view and edit alongside you, while every change syncs through iCloud.

WHY SUPPLIES?
- One place for your whole home. Track food, medicine, cleaning supplies, and everything else you keep, instead of relying on scattered notes or memory.
- Made for every room. Supplies works just as well for the garage, bathroom, or medicine cabinet as it does for the pantry.
- Private by default. There's no account to create, and everything syncs securely through your own iCloud.

Supplies is free to download. Start with your first inventory, assign labels, keep a checklist, and see everything on the expiration timeline at no cost. Supplies Plus adds multiple inventories, inventory sharing, custom labels, unlimited checklists, and expiration alerts, with a 14-day free trial.

Download Supplies and know what you have.

Privacy Policy: https://supplies-app.com/privacypolicy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

quotes.text:
Tl;dr: I built an app called Supplies (https://apps.apple.com/ee/app/supplies-home-inventory-app/id1503927871) to help me track and plan my food and other supplies.

When the lockdown started, I noticed I had a two food-related problems: 
1) I was used to stopping by the grocery store more or less every day on my way home from work so I had no habit of planning ahead for more than a few days at a time. 
2) In order to fit a week+ worth of food in my apartment, I had to distribute it between a few nooks and crannies which made it difficult to track what items I had where.

To help transition to my new once-a-week shopping schedule, I used Trello at first but that quickly grew unmanageable. So I decided to spend some time to build myself the right tool for the job. I realized other people may have run into the same issues I had so I tought I’d release it to the App Store.
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What's your quarantine side project?
